profile.reading:
This OpenStreetMap record at 19 College Avenue in Rexburg, Idaho, tagged as a telecom data center, is named VentureData. Venture Data, LLC is a real and active company, a telephone survey and market research firm headquartered in Orem, Utah, that has conducted political polling and public opinion research since 1994 for clients including NBC and the Wall Street Journal. Its public website describes computer aided telephone interviewing operations staffed by hundreds of trained interviewers, run from call center locations including one near Brigham Young University Idaho in Rexburg, a college town that has long supported a local call center industry drawing on student and local labor.

A calling center built around banks of interviewer workstations and telephone systems is a fundamentally different kind of facility from a data center built around server racks, cooling, and standby power for outside colocation customers. Nothing in Venture Data's public materials describes this Rexburg address as hosting server infrastructure for other companies, and the building most plausibly houses office space and interviewer stations rather than a data center in the sense this registry otherwise tracks. This entry is published without data center specifications because the underlying business, while real, does not appear to operate a colocation or hosting facility at this address.

reading.body:
This facility does not operate as a data center and does not contribute to Idaho's AI infrastructure compute capacity.

The Rexburg address tagged in OpenStreetMap as a telecom data center belongs to Venture Data LLC, a telephone survey and market research firm founded in 1994. The company operates call centers staffed by interview operators who conduct polling and public opinion research for clients including NBC and the Wall Street Journal. The Rexburg location near Brigham Young University Idaho is a call center office, not a colocation or hosting facility for server infrastructure.

No power or IT capacity specifications exist for this facility because it does not operate computing infrastructure for outside customers. The business runs telephone systems and workstations for its own operations only. This represents a classification error in the underlying OpenStreetMap data rather than a facility relevant to tracking AI's physical infrastructure footprint.

Idaho's mapped data center footprint contains zero published megawatts of IT load capacity. This entry serves primarily to document that not all facilities tagged as data centers in source materials operate as such, and that on-the-ground verification is necessary to distinguish call centers and office locations from the colocation and hosting facilities that provision compute for AI workloads.
